convert_tensor_message_to_numpy: convert a protobuf tensor message like FloatTensor or Int64Tensor to a numpy ndarray
convert_numpy_to_tensor_message: convert a numpy array to a protobuf tensor message like DoubleTensor or BooleanTensor
convert_range_message: convert a protobuf range message like Int64Range or FloatRange to a Scalar space object
convert_box_message: convert a protobuf box message like FloatBox or Int64Box to a gym Box space object
convert_sequence_space: convert a protobuf sequence space message like Int64SequenceSpace to a Sequence space object
